module PSR {
    craftRecipe WireCarBattery {
        timedAction = MakingElectrical,
        time = 80,
        category = Electrical,
        needToBeLearn = true,
        autoLearnAny = Electricity:4,
        skillRequired = Electricity:3,
        onCreate = Recipe.OnCreate.PSR_wireCarBattery,
        xpAward = Electricity:1,
        tags = AnySurfaceCraft,
        inputs {
            item 1 tags[Screwdriver] mode:keep flags[Prop1;MayDegradeLight;NoBrokenItems],
            item 1 [Base.ElectricWire],
            item 1 tags[CarBattery] mode:destroy flags[NoBrokenItems;ItemCount],
        }
        outputs {
            item 1 PSR.WiredCarBattery,
        }
    }
    craftRecipe UnWireCarBattery {

    /* Hardened "realistic" variant — only taught when sandbox PSR.HardenedPanelRecipe is ON.
       Same output as Make_Solar_Panel; adds tempered glass + aluminium frame, more cells,
       higher skill/time. The standard Make_Solar_Panel stays unchanged for default games. */
    craftRecipe Make_Solar_Panel_Realistic {
        category = Electrical,

        timedAction = MakingElectrical,

        skillRequired = Electricity:6,
